assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Tier 1 arena room background for a 2D cartoon vault-management game, wide landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: An EMPTY humble underground vault fighting arena drawn as a crisp, charming mobile-game cartoon. This is the basic DUEL tier.
Style: hand-drawn 2D cel-shaded illustration, confident dark outlines, chunky rounded industrial shapes, broad flat colors, two-tone shadows, slightly exaggerated proportions. Clearly cartoonish like Fallout Shelter room art. Avoid realism, photographic texture, painterly grime, 3D rendering and intricate microdetail.
Scene: steel-blue vault walls with a large round ventilation grille centered on the back wall, modest side chain-link partitions, simple brown wooden benches at the far sides, basic overhead warm lamps and exposed chunky pipes. A worn ochre practice circle on a plain muted warm-gray concrete floor. Small yellow hazard accents.
Composition: front-facing horizontal cutaway room with slight floor perspective. Upper 60 percent is back wall and infrastructure, lower 40 percent is the empty fighting floor. Leave fighter positions around x=35% and x=65%, y=80% completely clear. Entire room visible; no obstructing foreground props. Keep the same composition suitable for future upgraded variants.
Constraints: empty environment, no people, no creatures, no weapons, no gore, no fire, no smoke, no UI, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Opaque background.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D cartoon vault-management game arena background, landscape 1536x1024.
Input image 1 is the Tier 1 STYLE AND ROOM LAYOUT reference. Create an upgraded version of this exact room, maintaining the frontal camera, round central ventilation motif, steel-blue/ochre palette, chunky rounded shapes, confident dark outlines and crisp flat cel-shaded cartoon rendering. The room should look like a visible upgrade of the same cartoon game room. Do NOT become realistic, photographic, glossy 3D or intricately textured. Keep the lower 40 percent an EMPTY clear fighting floor, with actor positions x=35% and x=65%, y=80% unobstructed. No people, creatures, weapons, gore, smoke, fire, text, numbers, logos, UI or watermark. Opaque background. Keep the same camera and full-room framing.
Tier 2 BRAWL arena: replace simple side benches and chain-link partitions with chunky reinforced steel guardrails and compact raised spectator bench tiers tucked into the far sides behind the fight area. Upgrade overhead lighting to a row of bright industrial flood lamps. Add thicker support braces and neatly painted yellow hazard strips. The round rear grille remains recognizable. Floor practice circle becomes clean, boldly painted and has clear side starting marks. Noticeably more equipped and organized than Tier 1, but clearly simpler than a high-tech creature-containment arena.
